passes.name: serial-n per-op matmul
passes.approach: loop N rows, per-row matmul + epilogue
passes.note: pathologically slow (no batched AMX); diagnosed, discarded

passes.name: batched bmm bf16 + fused epilogue
passes.approach: one at::bmm over folded N*H rows -> AMX; single-pass relu*weight*sum epilogue

passes.name: tiled brgemm + per-tile fused epilogue
passes.approach: ATen cpublas::brgemm into L1 stack buffer; scores never leave cache (drops [N,H,S] DRAM round-trip)
passes.note: superseded by best-of (still loses to bmm at M=1 overhead-bound)

passes.name: best-of dispatcher (tiled M>=8 + bmm M=1)
passes.approach: pick tiled for M>=8, bmm for M=1

best.residual_gap_cause: primary lever (drop [N,H,S] score DRAM round-trip via L1/L2-resident tiled epilogue) EXHAUSTED; remaining gap to machine peak = achievable DRAM BW ~60% of 358 GB/s datasheet + sub-ms per-layer dispatch overhead. Not closable by further kernel work on this silicon.
